remainingEvidence: A root-authorized controlled invocation must establish that the actual configured credential helper returns the expected fixed GitHub credential without prompting.
The same invocation must establish the actual GitHub API 302 storage host is inside the explicit allowlist and that size, digest, ZIP custody, and offline materialization succeed.
Failure must remain a fixed closed category; no real credential, redirect Location, response body, or traceback may appear in command arguments, logs, receipts, or tool-call parameters.

retainedBoundaries.apiRequest: fixed api.github.com repository/artifact path with Bearer only on this request
retainedBoundaries.body: metadata-bounded expectedSize+1 read followed by exact size and public SHA-256 match
retainedBoundaries.cliAndErrors: no credential or signed URL accepted in CLI arguments; emitted failures contain fixed codes without remote body, headers, URL, repr, or traceback
retainedBoundaries.credentialAction: fill only; no approve or reject
retainedBoundaries.credentialInput: fixed protocol=https, host=github.com, and repository path over child stdin
retainedBoundaries.credentialOutput: bounded captured pipes, strict host/protocol/path/username/password parsing, fixed closed errors, no stdout/stderr forwarding
retainedBoundaries.materializer: existing offline materializer SHA-256 pin remains exact and retains metadata, ZIP CRC/path/casefold/budget, O_EXCL, fsync, and readback controls
retainedBoundaries.redirect: automatic redirect disabled; only HTTP 302 Location is retained in process memory and response is closed without reading its body
retainedBoundaries.storageRequest: separate request and opener with no Authorization or Cookie; HTTPS/no-userinfo/default-or-443/no-fragment/explicit Actions storage host checks

verifiedDelta.environmentScrub: All inherited case variants beginning GIT_TRACE, GCM_TRACE, or GCM_DEBUG are removed before fixed disabled values are installed.
verifiedDelta.gcmCredentialStore: GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE remains preserved so the configured noninteractive credential store is not silently changed.
verifiedDelta.gitAskpass: GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS are explicit empty strings, preventing fallback to configured core.askPass and SSH_ASKPASS.
verifiedDelta.hostileEnvironmentModel: A fixed fake environment proves hostile askpass, future trace/debug prefixes, secret/MSAUTH trace flags, and debugger flags are removed or disabled while PATH and GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE remain exact.
